Type 2 diabetes mellitus code sets (all versions)

Source: R/conditions.R
diabetes_type2_codes.Rd

get_diabetes_type2_vN_codes() returns the ICD code set for version N of the type 2 diabetes definition, and get_diabetes_type2_vN_defs() displays its narrative algorithm. Each version is frozen once released: later versions never change what an earlier version's functions return.

Every version has an alternative qualifying path of \(\geq\)1 pharmacy claim for an oral antidiabetic drug or insulin (see spec_diabetes_type2), and classifies patients into four mutually exclusive categories (no diabetes; diabetes without antidiabetic medication; diabetes with oral antidiabetic; diabetes with insulin).

Usage

get_diabetes_type2_v1_codes(
  code_type = NULL,
  variable_type = c("condition", "outcome"),
  periods = FALSE,
  priority = 1L
)

get_diabetes_type2_v1_defs(variable_type = c("condition", "outcome"))

get_diabetes_type2_v2_codes(
  code_type = NULL,
  variable_type = c("condition", "outcome"),
  periods = FALSE,
  priority = 1L
)

get_diabetes_type2_v2_defs(variable_type = c("condition", "outcome"))

Arguments

code_type

Optional character vector of code types to return. Valid values: "dx_icd9", "dx_icd10", "proc_icd9", "proc_icd10", "hcpcs", "cpt", "rev". NULL (default) returns all code types.

variable_type

"condition" (default) or "outcome". Type 2 diabetes is defined as a condition only; "outcome" falls back to condition codes.

periods

Logical. FALSE (default) returns short-format codes (e.g., "4010"). TRUE returns decimal-format codes (e.g., "401.0").

priority

Integer vector subsetting confidence tiers to include (1 = core, 2 = probable, 3 = cautious). Default 1.

Value

get_diabetes_type2_vN_codes(): a tibble with columns type, code, priority, version, and definition. get_diabetes_type2_vN_defs(): the narrative definition (displayed, and returned invisibly), or NULL.

Versions

v1

ICD-9 type 2/unspecified codes 250.x0/250.x2 plus complication codes 357.2, 362.0x, 366.41; and ICD-10 E11.xx, E08.xx, E09.xx, E13.xx.

v2

ICD-10 type 2 diabetes codes only: every billable E11 code, including E11.A (in remission). No ICD-9 codes, so claims before October 1, 2015 cannot qualify through the diagnosis criteria.

Version history

Every version below remains available. Compare any of them with get_version_diffs("diabetes_type2"); list them with list_versions("diabetes_type2").

  • v1: initial version (126 codes).

  • v2 (2026-10-22, 87 codes): ICD-10 type 2 diabetes codes (E11) only.

    • Why: A more specific definition. Drops all ICD-9 codes and the ICD-10 codes for diabetes due to an underlying condition (E08), drug- or chemical-induced diabetes (E09) and other specified diabetes (E13), keeping only type 2 diabetes (E11). Adds E11.A (type 2 diabetes without complications, in remission), the one billable E11 code missing from v1. Because no ICD-9 codes remain, claims before October 1, 2015 cannot qualify through the diagnosis criteria. The medication criterion is unchanged.

    • Codes compared with v1:

      • Removed 40 codes:

        • dx_icd9 (33): 250, 2500, 25000, 25002, 25010, 25012, 2502, 25020, 25022, 25030, 25032, 25040, 25042, 25050, 25052, 25060, 25062, 25070, 25072, 25080, 25082, 25090, 25092, 3572, 3620, 36201, 36202, 36203, 36204, 36205, 36206, 36207, 36641

        • dx_icd10 (7): E0836, E0842, E0936, E0942, E1310, E1336, E1342

      • Added 1 code:

        • dx_icd10 (1): E11A

See also

get_version_diffs(), list_versions(), spec_diabetes_type2_v1, spec_diabetes_type2_v2

Examples

get_diabetes_type2_v2_codes()
#> # A tibble: 87 × 5
#>    type     code    priority version definition                                 
#>    <chr>    <chr>      <int> <chr>   <chr>                                      
#>  1 dx_icd10 E1100          1 v2      Type 2 diabetes mellitus with hyperosmolar…
#>  2 dx_icd10 E1101          1 v2      Type 2 diabetes mellitus with hyperosmolar…
#>  3 dx_icd10 E1110          1 v2      Type 2 diabetes mellitus with ketoacidosis…
#>  4 dx_icd10 E1111          1 v2      Type 2 diabetes mellitus with ketoacidosis…
#>  5 dx_icd10 E1121          1 v2      Type 2 diabetes mellitus with diabetic nep…
#>  6 dx_icd10 E1122          1 v2      Type 2 diabetes mellitus with diabetic chr…
#>  7 dx_icd10 E1129          1 v2      Type 2 diabetes mellitus with other diabet…
#>  8 dx_icd10 E11311         1 v2      Type 2 diabetes mellitus with unspecified …
#>  9 dx_icd10 E11319         1 v2      Type 2 diabetes mellitus with unspecified …
#> 10 dx_icd10 E113211        1 v2      Type 2 diabetes mellitus with mild nonprol…
#> # ℹ 77 more rows
get_diabetes_type2_v2_defs()
#> ℹ Any of the following:
#> • ≥1 inpatient claim with a discharge ICD-10 type 2 diabetes diagnosis (E11.x:
#>   any billable E11 code, including E11.A for diabetes in remission) in any
#>   discharge position.
#> • ≥2 carrier/outpatient claims with the same ICD-10 codes in any position,
#>   occurring at least 7 days apart.
#> • ≥1 pharmacy claim for an oral antidiabetic drug or insulin (see
#>   spec_diabetes_type2).
#> ℹ Patients are then classified into four mutually exclusive categories: no
#>   diabetes; diabetes without antidiabetic medication; diabetes with oral
#>   antidiabetic (non-insulin); diabetes with insulin.
#> ! ICD-10 only: claims before October 1, 2015 (ICD-9 era) cannot qualify through
#>   the diagnosis criteria.

# What changed from v1 to v2?
get_version_diffs("diabetes_type2", versions = c(1, 2), changes_only = TRUE)

#>  9 TRUE  FALSE 25022 dx_icd9 Diabetes with hyperosmolarity, type II or u… remov…
